On the remembrance of Satyajit Ray on his Death Anniversary presenting the Bengali Classic Movie "Abhijan : িা" াংা ি on YouTube. The Bengali Film Abhijan was released in the year 1962, Directed by Satyajit Ray, starring Waheeda Rehman, Soumitra Chatterjee, Ruma Guha Thakurta, Rabi Ghosh, Shekhar Chatterjee & Others.
Movie : Abhijan
Language : Bengali
Genre : Drama, Classic
Producer : Bhola Nath Roy
Director : Satyajit Ray
Story : Tarasankar Bandyopadhyay
Music Director : Satyajit Ray
